description: This file defines the API functions for managing GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) parameters within a data model library. It includes function prototypes for getting and setting string parameter values related to GRE configurations.

methods.name: Gre_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the string value of a specified GRE parameter given the instance context, parameter name, buffer to store the value, and size pointer.

methods.name: Gre_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets the string value of a specified GRE parameter given the instance context, parameter name, and new value.
